summary: Implemented official Node reference SignalClient with durable transactions and explicit trust.17 package tests and typecheck pass including actual SIGKILL recovery. Independent Unicode contentHash issue fixed with RED/GREEN regression. Mobile/relay integration and independent audit remain open.

acceptance.criterion: Official session bootstrap/reply/reload/out-of-order/replay/tamper and rejected inbound/outbound trust pass.
acceptance.evidence: Official spike plus SignalClient.test.ts native+SQLite integration tests

acceptance.criterion: Session advancement and exact outgoing ciphertext persist in one transaction before return; retries do not re-encrypt and reject id reuse with different content.
acceptance.evidence: SIGKILL precommit/postcommit recovery, collision and surrogate regression

acceptance.criterion: Only explicit approved remote keys are trusted; no TOFU and no implicit replacement.
acceptance.evidence: Unknown/changed/revoked trust tests; approveRemote and establish refuse replacement/reset

acceptance.criterion: No imports into React Native; no release/device/security-audit claim.
acceptance.evidence: Separate session-node reference package; README and report explicitly retain limits
